raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions contains 145 txn_ids delivered more than once, and the copies are identical in every column (same batch_id and ingest_ts). The POSTED filter keeps 137 of them in silver_transactions, which inflates the counts and totals in every gold table. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver is safe because the copies are exact.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1"}}
